items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I played a long time with the band. Kid Rene. ... I played with all of them. Sam, Isaiah, Andrew, all of them.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know him well.
Pretty good. I don't know if you ever remember the ball would die. Kid Rene.
I just met him one night.
